questions: Do you have weakness in either leg?
Do you have numbness or altered sensation in either leg?
Do you have pain in your legs or back when walking?
Do you feel dizzy or as though you may lose consciousness while walking?
Can you walk normally when you are alone or not being watched?
Have you recently experienced significant psychological stress or trauma?
Have you fallen despite being able to walk this far?
Do you have difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
Did this unsteady walking begin suddenly, within the last few days?
Do you have trouble coordinating your hands, such as reaching accurately or writing?
Do you have slurred speech?
Do you have double vision or abnormal eye movements?
Do you have a persistent spinning sensation or severe imbalance even when sitting still?
Do you have hearing loss or ringing in either ear?
Have you recently consumed alcohol or taken sedatives, anticonvulsants, or other drugs that can impair coordination?
Do you have a severe headache, vomiting, or neck stiffness?
Have you had a recent head injury?
Do you have a family history of progressive balance or coordination problems?
Has the unsteady gait gradually worsened over weeks or months?
Has the slurred speech gradually worsened over weeks or months?
Do your walking or speech problems noticeably improve when you are distracted?
Do your symptoms vary substantially from one day to another?
Do you have difficulty swallowing or choking on food or liquids?
Do you have tremor or involuntary movements in your arms or legs?
Do you have stiffness, slowness, or reduced movement?
Do you have diabetes, thyroid disease, vitamin deficiency, or other chronic medical illness?
Are you taking any prescription or nonprescription medications regularly?
orders: Perform a bedside neurological gait examination with normal walking, tandem walking, heel and toe walking, single-leg stance, hopping, and walking while distracted.
MRI of the brain with and without gadolinium contrast, including posterior fossa and cerebellar sequences.
Serum vitamin B12, folate, copper, and ceruloplasmin levels.
Thyroid-stimulating hormone and free thyroxine levels.
Complete blood count, comprehensive metabolic panel, and serum glucose.
